item.title: Chiba Events 2026: Fireworks, Tokyo Game Show, Gion Festivals & Disney
item.description: Chiba is where most visitors land (Narita Airport) and where Tokyo Disney Resort actually sits — but the prefecture’s own 2026 event calendar is far richer than a transit stop suggests. It hosts some of the Kanto region’s biggest summer fireworks, two UNESCO-linked Gion float festivals on the same weekend, the world’s largest video-game show, a temple-steps display of thirty thousand hina dolls, and whale-and-dolphin watching off its Pacific coast. This guide gathers the events worth planning a 2026 trip around, with a month-by-month calendar at the end.
